crossRefs.note: “I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was ancient of days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair…
His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
“To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet…
His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one…
His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His…

translations.web: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.
translations.bsb: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.
translations.kjv: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
translations.asv: And his head and his hair were white as white wool, white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
